Name: Lnh's Coastal Farmhouse
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[center][size=4][b][color=#ffff00]一个新的海边农舍，它的名字叫做滨海农舍。[/color]
[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#00ff00]有3个版本可供选择：[/color][/b][/size][b][size=4][color=#00ff00]1.替换原版农舍，2.PIF版本，3.找罗宾建造，3个版本可以一起安装。[/color]
[color=#00ff00]There are 3 versions to choose from: 1. Replace Vanilla Farmhouse, 2. PIF version, 3. B[/color][b][color=#00ff00]uildable[/color][/b] [color=#00ff00]with Robin, 3 versions can be installed together.[/color]

[color=#c27ba0]已知bug：[/color]
[color=#c27ba0]1. 替换版本[/color][b][color=#c27ba0]每当换季第一天时，酒窖入口和配偶房间家具可能会消失，重新启动一次游戏即可恢复。[/color][/b]
[color=#c27ba0]2. 找罗宾建造的版本，鱼类出现的水域错乱，经过多次尝试，无法修复。[/color]
[color=#c27ba0]Known bugs:[/color]
[color=#c27ba0]1.Replaced version On the first day of each season, the wine cellar entrance and spouse room furniture may disappear, but reopening the game can restore them.[/color]
[color=#c27ba0]2.The buildable version has caused confusion in the water where fish appear, but after multiple attempts, it cannot be repaired.[/color][/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]替换版本的注意事项：[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]安装或者卸载或者升级农舍前，需要清空农舍内的所有物品（包括家具，制作物品，作物等等）[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][color=#6aa84f][size=4][b]开局需要手动挪一下床。[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]Notes on Replaced version：[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]Before installing, uninstalling, or upgrading the farmhouse, it is necessary to clear all items inside the farmhouse (including furniture, crafting items, crops, etc.) [/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]The new game requires you to move the bed by yourself.[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=4][color=#ffffff]兼容多配偶方法：
1. 首先安装多配偶mod，[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url]
2. 在可选文件中下载PolyamorySweetRooms文件，解压，会得到一个名为 [b]PolyamorySweetRooms的文件夹，Ctrl+C[/b]复制该文件夹。
3. 打开多配偶mod文件夹，Ctrl+V把刚刚复制的文件夹粘贴进来，选择替换。
Compatible with PolyamorySweet method：
1. First install 
2. Download the PolyamorySweetRooms file from the optional files,  decompress,  You will receive a folder named PolyamorySweetRooms,  [b]Ctrl+C Copy this folder.
[/b]3. Open the PolyamorySweet mod folder,  Ctrl+V paste the folder you just copied into it,  Choose replacement.[/color][/size]
[/b]
